title: محادثة 1: الكافتيريا
context: حوار حول وجبة الغداء في الكافتيريا
transcript:
M: Have you eaten lunch yet?
F: Not yet. I was waiting for you. Where should we go?
M: The cafeteria is serving pasta and salad today. It's only five dollars.
F: That sounds perfect. The Student Center is too crowded at this hour.
M: Agreed. Let's head to the cafeteria before the line gets long.
F: Good idea. Do they still have that lemon dressing I like?
M: I think so. Come on, let's go.

questions.q: Where are the students planning to go for lunch?
What kind of food is being served?

title: محادثة 2: المطعم الجديد
context: حوار عن افتتاح مطعم جديد قرب الحرم
transcript:
F: Did you hear about the new Italian place that just opened?
M: No, where is it?
F: Right across from the main gate. They have authentic pizza.
M: Sounds amazing. How are the prices?
F: A bit higher than the cafeteria, but worth it for a weekend treat.
M: Let's try it Saturday night then.
F: Perfect. I'll make a reservation for seven.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
When do they plan to go?

title: محادثة 1: بطاقة الطالب
context: طالب جديد يطلب بطاقة هويته الجامعية
transcript:
M: Hi, I'm a new student. Where do I get my ID card?
F: You'll need to go to the Student Services Office. It's in Building C.
M: Okay. What do I need to bring with me?
F: Your passport and the enrollment letter you received by email.
M: Got it. Is there a fee?
F: No, the first card is free. Just bring those two documents.
M: Perfect. Thanks for your help.

questions.q: Where should the student go to get the ID card?
What documents does the student need to bring?

title: محادثة 2: حساب البريد الإلكتروني
transcript:
F: Hi, I haven't received my university email account yet.
M: Let me check. Can I have your student ID number?
F: Sure, it's 2025-4471.
M: Okay, I see your account is ready. You can activate it at the IT Help Desk.
F: Where is that located?
M: Ground floor of the Library Building, next to the entrance.
F: Thank you. I'll go right now.

questions.q: What is the student's problem?
Where is the IT Help Desk located?
opts: Ground floor of the Library Building

title: محادثة 1: حفلة الطلاب
transcript:
F: Are you going to the student party on Friday?
M: Yes, definitely. My classmates from the engineering club are all going.
F: Oh nice. I wasn't sure if I should come alone.
M: You should come with us. The more, the merrier.
F: That's really kind. What time does it start?
M: Eight o'clock at the main hall. We can meet at the entrance.
F: Perfect. I'll be there.

questions.q: What event are the students talking about?
Who is the male student going with?

title: محادثة 2: نادي الكتاب
transcript:
F: Have you ever joined the book club?
M: No, but I've been curious about it.
F: We meet every Thursday at six in the lounge. It's really relaxed.
M: What kind of books do you read?
F: Mostly modern fiction. This month we're reading a novel by a Japanese author.
M: Sounds interesting. Can I just show up?
F: Absolutely. New members are always welcome.

questions.q: How does the male speaker feel about joining?
When does the book club meet?

title: محادثة 1: المقال البحثي
transcript:
M: Did you start the essay for Professor Adams?
F: Not yet. What were the requirements again?
M: Minimum five pages, double-spaced, and at least four academic sources.
F: Can we use online sources?
M: Only peer-reviewed journals. No regular websites or blogs.
F: Got it. So online is fine if it's academic.
M: Exactly. The university library database has plenty.

questions.q: What is the required minimum length of the essay?
Can the student use online sources?

title: محادثة 2: عرض تقديمي
transcript:
F: Quick question — how long should the presentation be?
M: Ten minutes maximum, including Q and A.
F: And do we need to use slides?
M: Slides are optional, but visuals are encouraged.
F: What about working in pairs?
M: This one is individual. Group work comes later in the semester.
F: Okay, thanks for clarifying.

questions.q: What is the maximum length of the presentation?
Can students work in pairs?

title: محادثة 1: عيادة الجامعة
transcript:
M: I think I'm coming down with a cold. Should I see a doctor?
F: You can go to the campus clinic. They handle minor illnesses.
M: Do I need an appointment?
F: Walk-ins are fine before noon. Just bring your student ID.
M: What about the cost?
F: It's completely free for enrolled students. Even medicine is included.
M: Wow, that's great. I'll head there now.

questions.q: Where should the student go for help?
Will the student have to pay for the consultation?

title: محادثة 2: تجديد وصفة طبية
transcript:
F: Hi, I need to refill my prescription. Can you help?
M: Of course. Do you have a copy of the original prescription?
F: Yes, it's right here from my doctor back home.
M: Perfect. We'll need to verify it, which takes about 24 hours.
F: Is there any cost?
M: The verification is free. The medicine itself depends on the insurance.
F: I have student insurance.
M: Then most likely it'll be covered. Come back tomorrow afternoon.

questions.q: What does the student want to do?
When should she come back?

title: محادثة 1: تغيير موعد الرحلة
transcript:
F: Hi, I need to change my return flight. The semester ended earlier than expected.
M: I see. What's your original date?
F: June 15. I'd like to move it to June 6 if possible.
M: Let me check availability. Yes, we have seats on the morning flight.
F: Is there a change fee?
M: Normally yes, but students get one free change per semester.
F: Oh wonderful. Please book it for June 6 then.
M: Done. You'll receive a confirmation email shortly.

questions.q: Why does the student want to change the flight?
opts: The semester ended earlier than expected
She wants to visit a friend

questions.q: When is the new flight scheduled?

title: محادثة 2: حقيبة مفقودة
transcript:
M: Excuse me, my luggage hasn't arrived on the carousel.
F: I'm sorry to hear that. Can I have your baggage tag?
M: Yes, here it is. The tag number is 4782.
F: Let me check the system. It seems your bag was delayed in Frankfurt.
M: When will it arrive?
F: Tomorrow morning around 10. We'll deliver it to your address.
M: Thank you. Is there compensation for essentials tonight?
F: Yes, the airline provides fifty dollars for emergency items.

questions.q: What is the man's problem?
How much compensation does the airline provide?

title: محادثة 1: حجز قاعة دراسة
transcript:
F: I'd like to book a group study room for tomorrow.
M: How many people will be using it?
F: Four of us, for about three hours.
M: Then you'll need room 204. It accommodates up to six.
F: What times are available?
M: From 2 PM onwards. The morning slots are already booked.
F: Let's go with 3 to 6 PM then.
M: Booked. Please arrive on time, rooms are released after 15 minutes.

questions.q: What does the student want to do?
What happens if students arrive late?
opts: The room is released after 15 minutes

title: محادثة 2: غرامة كتاب متأخر
transcript:
M: Hi, I'm returning this book. I know it's overdue.
F: Let me scan it. Yes, it's twelve days late.
F: The fine is fifty cents per day, so six dollars total.
M: I expected that. Can I pay by card?
F: Unfortunately, the system only accepts cash for fines.
M: Oh, I don't have cash on me right now.
F: That's fine. The amount will be added to your account, and you can pay within seven days.
M: Great, I'll come back tomorrow with cash. Thank you.

questions.q: How much is the total fine?
How can the fine be paid?

title: محادثة 1: زميل سكن مزعج
context: طالبة تشكو من جارها في السكن
transcript:
F: I'd like to file a complaint about my dormitory.
M: Of course. What's the issue?
F: My neighbor plays loud music until 2 AM almost every night.
M: Have you tried talking to them directly?
F: Yes, but the situation hasn't improved.
M: I understand. We can send a formal warning and even consider relocation if needed.
F: Relocation would actually be ideal. Is there a fee?
M: No, room transfers due to noise complaints are free.

questions.q: What is the student's complaint?
What is the proposed solution?
opts: Send a warning and possibly relocate

title: محادثة 2: تسرب مياه
context: طالب يبلغ عن خلل في الحمام
transcript:
M: There's water leaking from the bathroom ceiling in my dorm.
F: Oh, that needs urgent attention. Which building and room?
M: Building D, room 314.
F: I'll send a plumber within the hour. Are you using the bathroom now?
M: No, I turned off the water main as a precaution.
F: Smart thinking. Please stay in your room until the plumber arrives.
M: Will I need to move out temporarily?
F: Hopefully not. Most leaks like this are fixed within a few hours.

questions.q: What did the student do before calling?
How soon will help arrive?

title: محادثة 1: تجاوز موعد التسجيل
transcript:
F: Hi, I missed the registration deadline. Is there any way to still enroll?
M: Late registration is possible but requires approval from the department chair.
F: What do I need to do?
M: Fill out the late registration form and write a brief explanation of your reason.
F: I was in the hospital. I have documentation.
M: That should be accepted. Late fees are usually waived for medical reasons.
F: Where do I submit the paperwork?
M: Bring everything to the registrar's office before Friday.

questions.q: Why did the student miss the deadline?
Will she have to pay a late fee?
opts: No, it will be waived for medical reasons

title: محادثة 2: تغيير التخصص
context: طالب يستفسر عن إجراءات تغيير التخصص
transcript:
M: I'm thinking about changing my major from biology to psychology.
F: That's a significant decision. Have you spoken to an advisor in psychology?
M: Not yet. What does the process look like?
F: First, you meet with the psychology department advisor for approval.
F: Then you submit a change-of-major form before the end of the semester.
M: Will I lose any of my completed credits?
F: Many credits will transfer, but introductory psychology courses are required for your new major.
M: Okay, I'll set up that meeting first. Thank you.

questions.q: What is the first step in changing his major?
What will happen to his completed credits?
opts: He needs to retake them all

title: محادثة 1: مناقشة درجة منخفضة
transcript:
M: Professor, I'd like to discuss my midterm grade.
F: I figured you might. What's your concern?
M: I got a 65, but I felt I prepared well. I'm not sure where I went wrong.
F: Let me pull up your exam. Most of your errors were in essay section three.
M: What can I do to improve?
F: Focus on building stronger thesis statements and supporting evidence.
F: I also recommend the writing center for additional help.
M: Thank you, I'll go there this week.

questions.q: Why did the student visit the professor?
What does the professor recommend?

title: محادثة 2: طلب فرصة بحثية
context: طالبة تسأل عن المشاركة في بحث
transcript:
F: Professor, I read your paper on coral reefs and I'm fascinated.
M: Thank you. Are you considering marine biology as a career?
F: Yes. I was wondering if you accept undergraduate researchers.
M: Sometimes, when funding allows. Do you have lab experience?
F: Only basic lab skills from my biology courses.
M: That's a start. Send me your CV and a one-page proposal of your interests.
F: I'll have it ready by next week.
M: Excellent. We can meet again after I review your materials.

questions.q: What does the student want?
What does the professor ask her to submit?

title: محادثة 1: قرض دراسي
transcript:
F: I'm considering applying for a student loan, but I'm a bit nervous.
M: I understand. What concerns you most?
F: Repayment after graduation. I'm not sure I'll find a job right away.
M: That's a valid concern, but our loans have a six-month grace period after graduation.
F: Six months? That's helpful, but still feels tight.
M: If you face hardship, you can apply for income-based repayment.
F: So payments adjust to my actual salary?
M: Exactly. Many graduates use this option in their first year.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the student?
opts: She is anxious about future finances

questions.q: What is implied about the income-based repayment?
opts: It's commonly used by new graduates

title: محادثة 2: تأخر منحة
context: طالب يستفسر عن تأخر دفعة منحته
transcript:
M: I'm still waiting for my scholarship deposit. It was due last week.
F: Let me check your file. I see your paperwork is complete.
M: So why the delay?
F: It appears the bank verification took longer than usual this semester.
M: Will this affect my ability to pay tuition on time?
F: Don't worry. We've flagged your account so no late fees apply.
M: That's a relief. When can I expect the deposit?
F: Within three business days, latest.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the delay?
opts: It is a wider administrative issue this semester

questions.q: Why won't the student face late fees?
opts: His account has been flagged due to the delay

title: محادثة 1: استعداد للمقابلة
transcript:
F: I have a job interview next Tuesday. Could you help me prepare?
M: Certainly. Have you researched the company?
F: Briefly. I know they're in renewable energy.
M: Go deeper. Look at their recent projects and leadership.
F: What about practice questions?
M: We offer mock interviews. Would you like to schedule one for Friday?
F: Yes, that would be amazing. I'll prepare more research first.
M: Bring your notes Friday and we'll do a full simulation.

questions.q: What will the student most likely do before Friday?
What will happen during the Friday meeting?

title: محادثة 2: معرض الوظائف
context: طالب يستفسر عن معرض التوظيف القادم
transcript:
M: I want to attend the upcoming career fair, but I've never been to one.
F: Good first step. The fair has over 80 companies this year.
M: Should I dress formally?
F: Business attire is expected. Also bring at least ten copies of your CV.
M: Ten copies? That sounds like a lot.
F: It goes quickly. Some students leave with leads from five or six companies.
M: What if I don't know what to say at the booths?
F: We have a pre-fair workshop next Wednesday. I'd strongly recommend attending.

questions.q: What will the student most likely do next?
What does the speaker imply about CVs?

title: محادثة 1: استرداد بريد إلكتروني
transcript:
M: I forgot my email password and can't reset it.
F: Did you try the recovery email option?
M: Yes, but the recovery email is also my old high school account, which is closed.
F: That's the problem. We'll need to verify your identity manually.
M: How do I do that?
F: Come to the IT desk with your student ID and a second photo ID.
M: Will the process take long?
F: About fifteen minutes. After verification, we'll reset your password immediately.

questions.q: Why couldn't the student reset his password online?
opts: His recovery email account is closed

questions.q: What is the solution proposed?
opts: Manual identity verification at IT desk

title: محادثة 2: برنامج لا يعمل
context: طالبة تواجه مشكلة في برنامج جامعي
transcript:
F: The statistics software keeps crashing whenever I open large data sets.
M: Have you checked the system requirements?
F: Yes, my laptop meets them, but barely.
M: That might be the issue. The software needs significantly more RAM for big files.
F: Is there a solution that doesn't involve buying a new laptop?
M: You can access the same software remotely through our computer lab servers.
F: Really? That would be perfect for my thesis work.
M: I'll send you the login instructions and remote access guide via email.

questions.q: What is the root cause of the crashes?
What is the proposed workaround?
opts: Access software remotely via lab servers

title: محادثة 1: دراسة في الخارج
transcript:
F: I'm considering studying abroad next semester, but I'm hesitant.
M: What's holding you back?
F: I'm worried about delaying my graduation.
M: Many courses transfer back. Have you looked at partner universities?
F: Some, but the credit transfer rules are confusing.
M: Let's identify three programs where most credits transfer easily.
F: That would help. If credits transfer, I think I'd commit.
M: Then let's start there. I'll send program details tomorrow.

questions.q: What is the main factor influencing the student's decision?
What will the advisor do next?
opts: Send her details of three suitable programs

title: محادثة 2: تأجيل فصل دراسي
transcript:
M: I've been thinking about taking a leave of absence next semester.
F: That's a big decision. What's prompting it?
M: Burnout. I've taken heavy course loads for three semesters straight.
F: Have you considered a reduced course load instead?
M: I thought of that, but I really need a complete break.
F: Understood. A leave can be granted, but you'll need to formally re-enroll later.
M: Will my scholarship be affected?
F: It pauses during your leave and resumes when you return, if you maintain good standing.

questions.q: Why is the student considering a leave?
What happens to his scholarship during the leave?
opts: It pauses and resumes upon return

title: محادثة 1: مشروع تخرج معقد
context: طالبة تناقش متطلبات مشروع متعدد المراحل
transcript:
F: Professor, my research project has more variables than I expected.
M: That's common. Can you narrow your scope?
F: I tried, but reducing variables might weaken my conclusions.
M: What if you split it into two phases? Phase one explores; phase two confirms.
F: That sounds manageable. Would phase two be next semester?
M: Possibly, depending on your phase-one findings.
F: I like that approach. It feels more rigorous.
M: Excellent. Submit a revised proposal by Friday outlining both phases.

questions.q: What is the main concern of the student?
opts: Her project has too many variables

questions.q: What is the professor's suggested approach?
opts: Split the project into two phases

title: محادثة 2: نزاع حول درجة
context: طالب يطعن في درجة مع نبرة محترمة لكن قلقة
transcript:
M: Professor, may I discuss the grading on my essay?
F: Of course. What specifically concerns you?
M: I lost six points on the analysis section, but I'm not clear on the criteria.
F: Let me explain. Your argument was solid, but you relied heavily on one source.
M: I see. I focused on depth over breadth.
F: Both matter in academic writing. Try diversifying sources in your next paper.
M: Is there any chance to revise this essay?
F: Not for a grade change, but I'm happy to discuss revisions for your learning.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the student's tone?
What will most likely happen next?
opts: The student will discuss revisions for learning, not grades
